about: The shop's vocabulary (the team's planning note, products round, October 2026, Goals 3 and 4): 40 categories in 11 groups, and the qualities people with norms look for, per group. Core qualities are the shop's filters. Read by lib/shop/categories.ts, lib/shop/qualities.ts, scripts/import-products.mjs and the product research brief. Ids never change once used; labels can.

groups.label: Food
groups.description: Snacks, meals and drinks, with the textures and flavours people can count on.

groups.label: Allergies
groups.description: Food free of common allergens, and things that keep allergies safe.

groups.label: Clothes
groups.description: Clothing without tags, scratchy seams or tight elastic, and adaptive clothing.

groups.label: Sensitive skin
groups.description: Skin, hair, mouth and laundry products without fragrance or harsh ingredients.

groups.label: Self-care
groups.description: Sleep, hygiene, periods and winding down.

groups.label: Sensory
groups.description: Sound, light, touch, pressure, chewing and movement.

groups.label: Books
groups.description: Books about norms: lived experience, guides, books for children, and fiction.

groups.label: Movies & TV
groups.description: Films, series and documentaries with neurodivergent people in them.

groups.label: Apps
groups.description: Apps for routines, communication, focus and learning.

groups.label: Play & school
groups.description: Toys, video games, crafts, and things that help at school and work.

qualities.label: Sold in Canada
qualities.help: A Canadian store sells it, or the maker ships to Canada.

qualities.label: Made for adults
qualities.help: Sized, designed or written for adults, not only children.

qualities.label: Made for children
qualities.help: Sized, designed or written for children.

qualities.label: Made by or with neurodivergent people
qualities.help: The maker says neurodivergent people made it or helped design it.

qualities.label: Crunchy
qualities.help: A dry, crisp texture.

qualities.label: Soft
qualities.help: Soft or chewy, easy to bite.

qualities.label: Smooth, no lumps
qualities.help: One smooth texture with no bits or lumps.

qualities.label: Mild flavour
qualities.help: Plain or mild, without strong spices.

qualities.label: Same every time
qualities.help: A brand people rely on for the same taste, smell or feel each time.

qualities.label: Short ingredient list
qualities.help: Few ingredients, listed plainly.

qualities.label: No artificial colours
qualities.help: The maker says it has no artificial colours or dyes.

qualities.label: Single-serve packs
qualities.help: Portions in separate packs, easy to take along.

qualities.label: Gluten-free
qualities.help: The maker says it is gluten-free.

qualities.label: Dairy-free
qualities.help: The maker says it is dairy-free.

qualities.label: Peanut- and tree-nut-free
qualities.help: The maker says it is free of peanuts and tree nuts.

qualities.label: Egg-free
qualities.help: The maker says it is egg-free.

qualities.label: Soy-free
qualities.help: The maker says it is soy-free.

qualities.label: Free of the top allergens
qualities.help: The maker says it is free of the priority allergens (peanuts, tree nuts, milk, eggs, wheat, soy, sesame, fish, shellfish, mustard).

qualities.label: Vegan
qualities.help: The maker says it is vegan.

qualities.label: Tagless
qualities.help: No sewn-in tags: the label is printed or easy to remove.

qualities.label: Seamless or flat seams
qualities.help: No seams, or flat seams that don't rub (including seamless toes on socks).

qualities.label: Soft fabric
qualities.help: A fabric the maker describes as soft, such as cotton, bamboo or modal.

qualities.label: Relaxed fit
qualities.help: Loose, nothing tight.

qualities.label: Soft waistband
qualities.help: A covered, wide or no-elastic waistband.

qualities.label: Easy closures
qualities.help: Magnets, hook-and-loop or pull-on instead of small buttons and zips.

qualities.label: Easy to put on and take off
qualities.help: Wide openings, pull-on, or slip-on.

qualities.label: Gentle compression
qualities.help: A snug, even pressure that many find calming.

qualities.label: Breathable
qualities.help: Keeps cool: the maker describes it as breathable or moisture-wicking.

qualities.label: Fragrance-free
qualities.help: No added fragrance (not just 'unscented', which can still contain masking scents).

qualities.label: Dye-free
qualities.help: No added dyes or colours.

qualities.label: Hypoallergenic
qualities.help: The maker says it is hypoallergenic.

qualities.label: For sensitive skin
qualities.help: The maker says it is made for sensitive skin.

qualities.label: Eczema Society of Canada accepted
qualities.help: Carries the Eczema Society of Canada's Seal of Acceptance.

qualities.label: Light, non-greasy feel
qualities.help: Absorbs quickly without a sticky or greasy feel.

qualities.label: Unflavoured or very mild
qualities.help: Toothpaste or mouth care without mint or strong flavour.

qualities.label: Low-foam
qualities.help: Foams less (often SLS-free), which many find easier.

qualities.label: Easy detangling
qualities.help: Made to make brushing and combing gentler.

qualities.label: Turns down noise
qualities.help: Earplugs or ear defenders with a stated noise reduction (in dB).

qualities.label: Active noise cancelling
qualities.help: Electronic noise cancelling.

qualities.label: Gentle fit
qualities.help: Light, low clamping or low pressure on the head or ears.

qualities.label: Discreet
qualities.help: Low-profile, not obvious to others.

qualities.label: Blocks light
qualities.help: Blackout, tinted or light-filtering.

qualities.label: Dimmable or adjustable light
qualities.help: Brightness or colour can be turned down.

qualities.label: Silent to use
qualities.help: Makes no clicks, beeps or noise when used.

qualities.label: Weighted
qualities.help: Adds weight or deep pressure; the weight is listed.

qualities.label: Safe to chew
qualities.help: Made for chewing: food-grade, free of BPA, lead and phthalates, per the maker.

qualities.label: Washable
qualities.help: Machine-washable or dishwasher-safe.

qualities.label: Easy to carry
qualities.help: Small or light enough to take along.

qualities.label: By a neurodivergent author
qualities.help: The author shares the norm the book is about.

qualities.label: Plain language
qualities.help: Written or designed to be easy to read.

qualities.label: Audiobook
qualities.help: There is an audiobook edition.

qualities.label: For parents and caregivers
qualities.help: Written for the people supporting someone.

qualities.label: Canadian
qualities.help: Made, written or produced in Canada.

qualities.label: Neurodivergent main character
qualities.help: A main character or subject is neurodivergent.

qualities.label: Neurodivergent cast or creators
qualities.help: Neurodivergent people play the parts or made it, per its makers.

qualities.label: Captions
qualities.help: Closed captions or subtitles are available.

qualities.label: Audio description
qualities.help: A described-video track is available.

qualities.label: Family-friendly
qualities.help: Rated G or PG (or the book is for children).

qualities.label: No ads
qualities.help: The app shows no advertising.

qualities.label: Free
qualities.help: Free to use, or free to watch somewhere.

qualities.label: One-time price
qualities.help: Bought once, no subscription.

qualities.label: Subscription
qualities.help: Needs a monthly or yearly payment.

qualities.label: Works offline
qualities.help: Works without an internet connection.

qualities.label: Visual supports
qualities.help: Picture symbols, visual schedules or timers.

qualities.label: Customizable
qualities.help: Words, pictures, sounds or colours can be changed.

qualities.label: Works with screen readers
qualities.help: The maker says it works with VoiceOver or TalkBack.

qualities.label: iPhone and iPad
qualities.help: On Apple's App Store.

qualities.label: Android
qualities.help: On Google Play.

qualities.label: In a web browser
qualities.help: Works on a website, no download.

qualities.label: GPS location
qualities.help: Shows where someone is on a map.

qualities.label: No subscription
qualities.help: Nothing to pay after buying it.

qualities.label: Hard to remove
qualities.help: Designed so it can't easily be taken off or undone.

qualities.label: No tools to install
qualities.help: Installs without drilling or tools.

qualities.label: Sends alerts
qualities.help: Alerts a phone, or sounds an alarm, when a door opens or someone leaves an area.

qualities.label: Open-ended play
qualities.help: No single right way to play.

qualities.label: Cooperative
qualities.help: Played together, not against each other.

qualities.label: Picture instructions
qualities.help: Instructions with pictures or steps.

qualities.label: Non-toxic
qualities.help: The maker says it is non-toxic.

qualities.label: Easy grip
qualities.help: Chunky, easy-grip or adapted for hands that find small items hard.

qualities.label: No time pressure
qualities.help: No timers or racing the clock: play at your own pace.

qualities.label: No chat with strangers
qualities.help: There is no open chat with people you don’t know, or it can be turned off.

qualities.label: No in-app purchases
qualities.help: Nothing more to buy inside it.

qualities.label: Chewy
qualities.help: A chewy texture, which some people love and others avoid.
